scope: Returned short command reasons compared with recorded public sensors/images and replay; private terminal decomposition diagnoses outcome separately. No hidden reasoning exported.

first_observable_execution_divergence.observation: Approach and descent ended 125.93 and 75.43 mm short while still moving; closure reached within 5.45 mm. Nonarrival precedes failed acquisition but does not isolate its cause.

first_manipulation_failure.evidence: Empty-sized closure interrupts attempted lift after ten steps; Astra observes frame on table. Second lower retry also ends empty and interrupts at step 242.
first_manipulation_failure.uncertainty: Recovery changes depth, centering and orientation together; no single grasp parameter cause isolated.

recovered_phases.observation: Re-centered, differently oriented grasp retains and lifts frame.

later_failures.evidence: Frame insertion stops 50.44 then 36.58 mm short. Release reaches its pose, withdrawal remains 93.78 mm short; frame assembly never passes.
Astra observes shifted frame and re-measures. Subsequent descent remains 21.16 mm short. Release/withdraw targets arrive closely, but tool falls; Astra explicitly acknowledges failure.
Recovery lift stalls 61.80 then 151.51 mm short with tool caught on stand shaft. Astra releases and clears hand.

terminal_failure.evidence: Public terminal image shows tool low at the stand shaft rather than suspended on horizontal hook. Both native task relations fail and neither ever passed.
terminal_failure.completion_judgment: Correct failure acknowledgment; no false full-success claim. Describing frame as upright does not establish native seating.

query_contribution.claim: Baseline retains equal public robot model/helper and calculation access; uses ordinary logged rotation calculations.

time_limitation: Original policy context/budget resumed after exact 1912-step observable reconstruction. Original hidden full prefix unavailable; host origin approximate/interrupted. All native policy-turn times measured; no elapsed-speed claim.
boundary: All 30 tool bodies and two public-data calculations manually reviewed. Instruction/audit boundary, no OS sandbox.
